Для оценки укажите рост и вес, а лучше е: For an estimate, enter your height and weight, and ideally your waist and neck measurements.
По росту, талии и шее (метод ВМС США) с: Based on height, waist and neck (US Navy method), adjusted with other formulas. Error is about ±3–4 %.
По росту и талии. Добавьте замер шеи — о: Based on height and waist. Add a neck measurement to make it more accurate.
Грубая оценка по росту и весу: она не от: A rough estimate from height and weight: it cannot tell muscle from fat. Add waist and neck measurements.
Наведите на линию на схеме, чтобы увидет: Hover a line on the diagram to see how to take the measurement correctly.
Записей пока нет. Добавьте первую на вкл: No entries yet. Add the first one on the “Entry” tab.
Если включён раздельный ввод — меряйте п: If separate entry is on, measure the right and left sides separately.
Лента — на середине шеи, чуть ниже кадык: Place the tape around the middle of the neck, just below the Adam's apple. Snug, but not digging in. Head straight, eyes forward, shoulders relaxed.
Обхват по самым широким точкам дельтовид: Measure around the widest points of the deltoids, with the tape level across the chest and shoulder blades. Stand straight with your arms relaxed at your sides.
Лента проходит на уровне сосков и под по: The tape runs at nipple level, under the armpits and across the shoulder blades. Arms down, measure after a relaxed exhale; the tape is level and not digging in.
Измеряется на уровне пупка, на спокойном: Measure at navel level after a relaxed exhale: don't suck in or push out your stomach. Keep the tape level. This measurement, together with neck and height, is used to estimate body fat.
По самой выступающей части ягодиц, лента: Around the most prominent part of the glutes, tape level. Stand straight, feet together, muscles relaxed.
Середина плеча между плечевым суставом и: The middle of the upper arm between shoulder and elbow, arm relaxed and hanging. Tape perpendicular to the arm. Pick one way (relaxed or flexed) and stick to it.
В самой толстой части, примерно на треть: At the thickest part, about a third of the forearm's length below the elbow. Arm relaxed, palm facing forward.
В самой толстой части, примерно на 5–10: At the thickest part, about 5–10 cm below the gluteal fold. Weight on both legs, muscles relaxed, tape level.
В самой широкой части икры. Стойте прямо: At the widest part of the calf. Stand straight with your weight on both legs, muscles relaxed.
Отключённый замер не показывается, но уж: A disabled measurement is hidden, but values you already entered are kept.
Руки: бицепс и предплечье. Ноги: бедро и: Arms: biceps and forearm. Legs: thigh and calf. When off, a single combined value is entered.
All measurements are disabled in settings.
Данных пока нет. Добавьте запись на вкла: No data yet. Add an entry on the “Entry” tab.
Линия — сглаженный тренд, точки — отдель: The line is a smoothed trend and the dots are individual entries, so daily fluctuations don't distort the picture.
